purpose: COMEN02Y defines CARDDEMO-MAIN-MENU-OPTIONS, the static option table of the regular-user main menu. It holds an option count (11) and a literal table of 46-byte entries (option number, 35-character display name, 8-character target program, 1-character allowed user type), redefined as the array CDEMO-MENU-OPT OCCURS 12. COMEN01C uses it to build the menu lines, to validate the entered option number against the count, to block admin-only entries for regular users and to resolve the XCTL target program.

key_fields.name: CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT
key_fields.meaning: Number of active main-menu options (VALUE 11); upper bound for option validation and menu-building loop in COMEN01C.

key_fields.name: CDEMO-MENU-OPTIONS-DATA
key_fields.meaning: Literal table: 1 Account View COACTVWC, 2 Account Update COACTUPC, 3 Credit Card List COCRDLIC, 4 Credit Card View COCRDSLC, 5 Credit Card Update COCRDUPC, 6 Transaction List COTRN00C, 7 Transaction View COTRN01C, 8 Transaction Add COTRN02C, 9 Transaction Reports CORPT00C, 10 Bill Payment COBIL00C, 11 Pending Authorization View COPAUS0C; all with user type 'U'.

key_fields.name: CDEMO-MENU-OPT
key_fields.meaning: Array view (OCCURS 12) over the literal table, subscripted by the option number.

key_fields.name: CDEMO-MENU-OPT-NUM
key_fields.meaning: Option number shown on the menu line.

key_fields.name: CDEMO-MENU-OPT-NAME
key_fields.meaning: Option description shown on the menu and used in 'not installed'/'coming soon' messages.

key_fields.name: CDEMO-MENU-OPT-PGMNAME
key_fields.meaning: CICS program XCTLed to when the option is chosen; 'DUMMY' prefix means placeholder, COPAUS0C is checked with INQUIRE PROGRAM first.

key_fields.name: CDEMO-MENU-OPT-USRTYPE
key_fields.meaning: User type allowed for the option; 'A' marks admin-only (blocked for CDEMO-USRTYP-USER in COMEN01C), 'U' available to regular users.

observations.text: The redefining array CDEMO-MENU-OPT OCCURS 12 (552 bytes) is larger than the 11-entry literal table it redefines (506 bytes); entry 12 has no defined content and a REDEFINES larger than the redefined item below level 01 is non-standard.
Header comment says 'CardDemo - Admin Menu Options' although the copybook defines the main (user) menu.
Option 8 originally read 'Transaction Add (Admin Only)' (commented out) and is now flagged 'U'; no option uses user type 'A', so the admin-only check in COMEN01C never fires.
